responsibility: Exported interface header for the NVPTX backend implementation in nvptx.cc and nvptx-c.cc. It declares the target’s assembler-output helpers, builtin and expansion entry points, OpenACC/OpenMP lowering helpers, operand/output formatting routines, memory-space predicates, shuffle support, and PTX-version conversion routine, providing the cross-file API used by headers, machine-description generated code, and target support code.
